HomePage.description: The Ministry of Mines digital platform for planning, conducting and reviewing field inspections of licensed exploration and mining companies across Ethiopia. Inspection teams complete standard checklists on site, every visit is verified by location, and results reach decision-makers as soon as they are submitted.

staffAccess.title: Staff & inspector access
staffAccess.subtitle: For Ministry of Mines staff and assigned inspection teams.

points.assigned: See the companies and inspections assigned to your team
points.checklist: Fill the field monitoring checklist on your phone, with photos and evidence
points.location: Your location is recorded at check-in and submission to confirm the site visit

staffAccess.hint: Accounts are created by the system administrator. Contact your supervisor if you need access.

features.title: What the system covers
features.subtitle: One place for licensed companies, inspection teams, checklists and results.

companies.title: Companies & licenses
companies.text: Register exploration and mining license holders with their license number, mineral, region, zone and woreda.

teams.title: Inspection teams
teams.text: Form teams of inspectors, assign them to companies and plan repeated inspection rounds.

checklists.title: Digital checklists
checklists.text: Build checklists once and reuse them for many companies — legal compliance, OSH, environment, community and production.

verification.title: On-site verification
verification.text: GPS location and device details are captured with every inspection, so supervisors know each visit really happened.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From planning a round to a reviewed inspection report.

plan.title: Plan the round
plan.text: Supervisors open an inspection round and assign teams and checklists to companies.

checkin.title: Check in on site
checkin.text: Inspectors check in at the company site; location and device are recorded.

inspect.title: Inspect & submit
inspect.text: The team fills the checklist with evidence and photos, then submits it with signatures.

review.title: Review & follow up
review.text: Supervisors review the report, findings are tracked to closure and the dashboard updates.

footer.rights: Ministry of Mines, Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia.
